for r in rows:
 if r['sample']<0:continue
 name=('file200' if r['command']==11 else 'direct_file200') if r['workload']=='original' else f"shape{r['shape']}_stage{r['stage']}"
 groups[(r['mode'],r['version'],r['block'],name)].append(r)
summary=[]
for (mode,version,block,name),rr in groups.items():
 r={'mode':mode,'version':version,'block':block,'workload':name,'samples':len(rr),'wall_ms':statistics.median(x['wall_ns']/1e6 for x in rr),'range_ms':[min(x['wall_ns']/1e6 for x in rr),max(x['wall_ns']/1e6 for x in rr)],'cpu_ms':statistics.median(x['cpu_seconds']*1000 for x in rr)}
 if mode=='coarse':
  r['translation_ms']=statistics.median(x['metrics']['translate']['inclusive_ns']/1e6 for x in rr)
  r['preparation_ms']=statistics.median(x['metrics']['tr_rules']['exclusive_ns']/1e6 for x in rr)
  r['leases_ms']=statistics.median(x['metrics']['tr_leases']['inclusive_ns']/1e6 for x in rr)
  r['disposal_ms']=statistics.median(x['metrics']['tr_dispose']['inclusive_ns']/1e6 for x in rr)
 if mode=='count':
  r['map_allocations']=sorted(set(x['metrics']['allocation_sites']['tr_rule_insert']['count'] for x in rr))
  r['map_bytes']=sorted(set(x['metrics']['allocation_sites']['tr_rule_insert']['bytes'] for x in rr))
  r['total_allocations']=sorted(set(x['metrics']['allocations']['count'] for x in rr))
  r['blocks_allocated']=sorted(set(x['metrics']['tr_blocks_allocated']['count'] for x in rr))
  r['blocks_released']=sorted(set(x['metrics']['tr_blocks_released']['count'] for x in rr))
  assert r['blocks_allocated']==r['blocks_released']
 summary.append(r)
(p/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
for r in summary:print(json.dumps(r))
